title: Notice of public hearing: Juniper Creek trail extension, phase 2
summary: The City Council will hold a public hearing on October 13 at 6 pm on the proposed trail extension and its use of parkland.
body:
The City Council will hold a public hearing on October 13 at 6 pm on the proposed trail extension and its use of parkland.

The full notice is attached. Questions go to the Parks and Recreation department. Written comments may be sent to the City Secretary, 300 W Main St, Juniper Falls, TX, before the hearing or deadline date.
